caption: The video captures a coastal beach scene under clouds tinted orange, yellow, and blue-grey, with a low warm glow near the horizon. A band of ocean sits at mid-frame, where a breaking wave carries a crest of white foam that rolls slowly toward the shore. The foam line shifts and deforms across the water, while the surface between the foam bands ripples continuously. In the foreground, a wide expanse of wet sand mirrors the sky, showing warm golden-orange reflections on the left and cool teal-cyan reflections on the right. A thin sheet of water advances and retreats slightly over the sand, reshaping and re-brightening those mirrored colors. The horizon line stays level. The view remains largely stable.
relations: The breaking wave's foam crest rolls shoreward, shifting and deforming the foam line across the water.
A thin sheet of water advancing and retreating over wet sand reshapes and re-brightens the mirrored sky colors.
The wet sand mirrors the sky, keeping warm golden reflections left and cool teal right as the water moves.
The horizon line stays level while the overall view remains largely stable.
